en-US.author: klNuno
en-US.description: One-click account switcher for Steam, Valorant, League of Legends, Battle.net, Epic Games, Ubisoft Connect, Roblox and Discord. No passwords stored.
en-US.longDescription:
Accshift switches game launcher accounts in one click, without signing out or retyping a password.

It works with each launcher's own remember-me mechanism rather than against it: the session the launcher already saved is captured, one snapshot is kept per account on your machine, and the right one is restored when you switch. No password is ever typed into accshift, stored by it or sent anywhere. Sensitive material is encrypted at rest with Windows DPAPI.

Supported on Windows: Steam, Riot Games (Valorant, League of Legends, Teamfight Tactics), Battle.net (Overwatch 2, Diablo IV, World of Warcraft, Call of Duty), Epic Games (Fortnite, Rocket League), Ubisoft Connect (Rainbow Six Siege, The Division 2), Roblox, and in testing GOG Galaxy, Jagex Launcher and Discord.

Also includes personas to switch several launchers at once, a streamer mode that blurs account names and avatars while OBS, Streamlabs, XSplit, Wirecast or Twitch Studio is running, folders, search and a command palette, plus a scriptable command-line binary and accshift:// deep links for Stream Deck and automation.

The interface is available in English, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian and Simplified Chinese, with light, dark and custom themes.
en-US.name: Accshift
en-US.releaseNotes:
Changes
- Windows startup goes from 410 to 297 ms (median of 30 launches).
- A new install opens at 1000x680 so the whole onboarding fits, and the window never opens larger than the screen.
- Windows 11 Snap Layouts work on the maximize button.
- Folder menu: move an account into a nested folder from the card.
- A selected card asks for a second click before switching.
- Changing or removing a PIN asks for the current one, and repeated wrong codes add a delay. The CLI checks the PIN the same way as the app.

Fixes
- Saving, capturing, refreshing or switching never writes one account's session into another account's profile (Riot, Steam, Epic, GOG, Ubisoft, Battle.net, custom platforms).
- An unreadable config file blocks saving instead of wiping your accounts.
- Forgotten Epic, GOG and Ubisoft accounts stay forgotten.
- A failed switch reopens the launcher. Battle.net relaunches only after a successful switch.
- An empty registry.vdf no longer breaks a Steam switch.
- Local edits (notes, colours, personas) survive a refresh that returns stale data.
- Refresh reports partial or failed results instead of claiming success.
- Onboarding stays open if consent fails to save. A failed theme save restores the preview.
- No more grey inner border on Windows 10.
- The window keeps its size at scaling above 100% instead of growing at every launch.
- accshift switch no longer hangs a caller that pipes its output.
- Logs and diagnostic reports redact profile paths, deep links and UUIDs.
- Plaintext backups left from before the encryption migration are deleted.
- Error toasts stay until dismissed.

Install notes
- Windows: run the .exe (NSIS) installer.
- Linux: install the .deb / .rpm, or chmod +x the .AppImage and run it.
- macOS (Apple Silicon): the app is not yet notarized. After copying Accshift.app to Applications, clear the quarantine flag once: xattr -cr /Applications/Accshift.app.
